This 2023 Toyota Sienna LE 8 Passenger provides a practical and comfortable solution for families and those who value versatility in a mid-size van. Finished in gray with a well-maintained interior, this vehicle delivers reliable transportation with a thoughtful set of features designed for everyday convenience.

- Roof rails for enhanced cargo versatility
- Power driver seat with mounted armrest for personalized comfort
- Lane Departure Warning System for added safety awareness
- Fully automatic and auto-dimming headlights for optimal visibility
- Heated door mirrors for winter driving conditions
- Front bucket seats with fabric upholstery
- Reclining 3rd row seats for passenger flexibility
- 17" alloy wheels on a responsive suspension system
- Rear air conditioning with front dual zone climate control
- SiriusXM satellite radio with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility
- Rear parking camera for convenient maneuvering
- Split folding rear seat for expanded cargo configurations
- Emergency communication through Toyota Safety Connect (1-year trial included)
- Electronic Stability Control and comprehensive brake system with ABS

The Sienna is powered by a 2.5L four-cylinder engine paired with a continuously variable transmission, delivering 36 mpg in both city and highway driving. This efficiency makes the van an economical choice for regular commuting and longer journeys alike. The front-wheel-drive configuration provides reliable traction in various weather conditions.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, front and rear side impact airbags, knee airbags, and an overhead airbag system. The vehicle is equipped with Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and brake assist to help maintain control in challenging driving situations. Four-wheel independent suspension combined with speed-sensing steering contributes to confident handling.

The spacious three-row seating arrangement accommodates up to eight passengers comfortably. The third-row seats feature a split-bench design with reclining capability, allowing you to configure the interior to suit your needs. Fabric upholstery is easy to maintain for family use, and the split folding rear seat provides flexibility for cargo and passenger combinations.

Climate control is managed through front dual zone automatic temperature control, while rear air conditioning keeps passengers in the back comfortable. The rear window defroster and variably intermittent wipers ensure visibility during inclement weather. Remote keyless entry and an illuminated entry system add convenience to daily operation.

Interior comfort and connectivity features include steering wheel-mounted audio controls, a trip computer, telescoping and tilting steering wheel, and multiple reading lights throughout the cabin. The rear seat center armrest and passenger seat-mounted armrest provide additional comfort for longer drives. An outside temperature display and compass add practical information at a glance.

We invite you to visit our showroom to see this 2023 Toyota Sienna LE 8 Passenger in person and experience the spacious cabin and smooth ride firsthand.

  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. This 2024 Chrysler Pacifica Hybrid Pinnacle at Whitewater CDJR in St. Charles combines three-row versatility with plug-in hybrid efficiency and luxury-level comfort.

Finished in Bright White Clearcoat, this CARFAX One-Owner Pacifica Hybrid has only 34,680 miles.

Plug-In Hybrid Efficiency

The Pacifica Hybrid combines a 3.6L V6 with two electric motors and a 16-kWh lithium-ion battery, producing 260 horsepower.

The result is a listed 32 miles of all-electric driving range, 82 MPG combined, and approximately 520 miles of total gas-and-electric range.

That means many shorter daily drives can potentially be completed using electric power while the gasoline engine remains available for longer family trips.

Using 240-volt charging, the listing specifies approximately 2 hours for a full charge.

Pinnacle Luxury

As the premium Pacifica trim, the Pinnacle gives families considerably more than basic minivan transportation.

Inside you'll find premium Nappa leather seating, heated and ventilated front seats, heated steering wheel, power front seats, driver memory, tri-zone climate capability, second-row captain's chairs, and seating for seven.

A power moonroof adds an open feel to the cabin, while the power liftgate makes loading groceries, luggage, sports equipment, and strollers easier.

Family Entertainment Built In

Long drives become easier with the rear entertainment system featuring dual second-row screens and Amazon Fire TV.

A 20-speaker Harman Kardon premium audio system provides impressive sound throughout the cabin.

Up front, the 10.1-inch Uconnect 5 Navigation system provides Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, Bluetooth, SiriusXM 360L, navigation, and wireless phone charging.

Three Rows + Serious Cargo Space

The Pacifica Hybrid seats seven and provides approximately 32 cubic feet of cargo room behind the third row and up to 140 cubic feet of maximum cargo capacity.

That gives families the flexibility to carry passengers during the week and transform the rear of the van for larger loads when needed.

Advanced Safety Technology

Driver-assistance features include Adaptive Cruise Control, Forward Collision Warning Plus, pedestrian detection, Lane Departure Warning Plus, Blind Spot Detection, Rear Cross Path Detection, front and rear parking sensors, and a 360° Surround View Camera.

Who Is This Pacifica Hybrid Best For?

This Pacifica is ideal for families who want three-row space without giving up the ability to drive on electricity for shorter trips.

It's especially attractive for parents with regular school, daycare, sports, and commuting routes who can charge at home, while still needing the flexibility of a gasoline engine for longer road trips.

Shoppers comparing the Chrysler Pacifica Hybrid with the Toyota Sienna, Honda Odyssey, Kia Carnival, or traditional three-row SUVs should pay close attention to this Pinnacle's combination of 32-mile EV range, seven-passenger seating, Nappa leather, ventilated seats, rear entertainment, Harman Kardon audio, 360° cameras, and premium family comfort.
